title: Operon-S1: a fast decision controller for long-horizon biomedical agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41350v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-model agents now carry out long scientific work in biology, but their judgements about conventions, skills, errors, evidence and stopping are made inside the reasoning that does the work, where they cannot be measured, replaced or improved on their own. Here we present Operon-S1, a fast decision system, a System 1 for the agent, that separates judging from doing. A decision harness poses the agent's recurring judgements as closed questions at 13 decision points and acts only through fixed messages that never contain an answer, so any model that answers the questions can serve as the judge. Across seven life-science benchmarks, a local decision model took over these judgements in 0.6 s at the median for an in-loop request on CPU at no request cost, with no measurable change in the agent's score on five of six benchmarks, whereas the general language model that drives the agent, asked the same questions, accounted for 8.0% to 35

translated_title: Operon-S1：面向长时程生物医学智能体的快速决策控制器
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体如今已能够承担生物学中的长周期科学工作，但它们对规范、技能、错误、证据以及何时停止的判断都发生在执行工作的推理过程内部，因而无法被单独测量、替换或改进。我们提出了Operon-S1——一个快速决策系统，即智能体的“系统1”（System 1），它将判断与执行分离开来。该决策框架将智能体反复出现的判断形式化为13个决策点上的封闭式问题，并且仅通过从不包含答案的固定消息来采取行动，因此任何能够回答这些问题的模型都可以充当裁判。在七个生命科学基准测试中，一个本地决策模型在CPU上以0.6秒的中位延迟接管了这些判断（针对循环内请求），且无需任何请求成本；在六个基准中的五个上，智能体的得分没有可测量的变化；而驱动智能体的通用语言模型在回答相同问题时，占用了8.0%到35……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出Operon-S1，一个将“判断”与“执行”分离的快速决策控制器，通过在13个决策点上提出封闭式问题让任意本地模型充当裁判，使生物医学智能体的循环内判断以0.6秒中位延迟、零请求成本完成，且不损害智能体的任务表现。
en_tdlr: Operon-S1 is a fast decision controller that separates judging from doing in long-horizon biomedical agents by casting recurring judgments as closed questions at 13 decision points, enabling a local model to answer them in 0.6s median latency at zero request cost without degrading agent performance.
